# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands (as of Oct 2026)

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**
- It charges an iPhone at 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods sit on the base, and the iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy.
- It has a 36W power supply with a permanently attached cable and a 2-year warranty.
- WIRED lists it at $98, with $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
- WIRED's review and shop links: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station**
- WIRED calls it the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 it has found. It charges at 15W, and the charger and cable are included.
- The Apple Watch charger is a separate unit that slots into the back, and the warranty is only 1 year.
- It's listed at $40 on Amazon, down from $80.
- Link: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It delivers Qi2 25W to the iPhone and has a heavy base and a braided cable.
- It has no power adapter, so you'll need a 40W one. WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter for $25.
- Link: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Best flat pad: Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130)**
- It supports Qi2 25W and lies flat for sleeping, and the pads can pop up for StandBy or Nightstand mode.
- Apple Watch charging is slow, so it's best left overnight.
- Link: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Best for travel or a desk**
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2), about $80:** a compact folding charger with 15W for the iPhone. The review is at https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W), $129.99:** Macworld says it's the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand. It comes with a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs. The review is at https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html
- **ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2 25W), $99.99:** it has a cooling fan with an off button and a 50W adapter. Buy here (affiliate link): https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand. That page says code PARTNER18 brings it to about $82 through 12/31/2026, but check at checkout.

## Which should you pick?
- **Most people:** the Belkin. It's well reviewed and costs about $80–$98.
- **Tight budget:** the ESR Qi2 at about $40.
- **Faster charging:** the 25W models (Nomad, Nimble, Satechi, ESR CryoBoost) only reach 25W on iPhone 16 and 17 series models. ESR's page says other iPhones get 15–20W. WIRED notes that if you charge overnight, 25W makes little difference.

Check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging, since the third position won't work with the original non-wireless cases.

I only have the product links listed above. For the others, the WIRED pages have the retailer links.
